windowTiers.name: Expansive
windowTiers.condition: width >= 1440 CSS px and height >= 800 CSS px

windowTiers.name: Standard
windowTiers.condition: otherwise, width >= 1100 CSS px and height >= 700 CSS px

windowTiers.name: Compact
windowTiers.condition: otherwise, width >= 760 CSS px and height >= 560 CSS px
windowTiers.authoringSupport: full only while center stage >= 480 x 360 CSS px

notes: Authoring is represented by no active runtime, not by a runtime-mode enum value.
Presenter View is the Presenter surface role, not a runtime mode.
Fullscreen and Windowed are placement values, not runtime modes.
Reading is not a canonical mode; the equivalent nonauthoring workflow is Preview.
